# /fc:sync-sdlc

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/sync-sdlc.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/sync-sdlc.md instead. -->

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:sync-sdlc` |
| Codex name | `$fc-sync-sdlc` |
| Kind | Plugin-level command — works in any repo |
| Description | Inspect workspace drift; generate host pointers only when explicitly requested |
| Arguments | none |

## Usage

Run it after pulling a new plugin version, or when `/fc:*` commands seem missing or out of date. It only applies to a repo with the `ai-factory/` layout. By default it is strict: it reports layout drift against the installed templates and writes no file outside the workspace. Taking upstream changes stays a separate, reviewable edit that keeps your local changes.

Host adapters are opt-in: pass `--adapters=` with `claude`, `codex`, `cursor`, `routing` or a comma-separated combination, only for the hosts you want. `routing` writes only the model-routing agents the workspace's `routing:` configuration requires and removes stale ones; `claude` and `codex` include it. Restart the session after generating routing agents.

It also says in one line when artifact contracts are available but not enabled.

See also: [Installation: stay current](../installation.md#4-stay-current-fcsync-sdlc), [workflow.md §7](../../ai-factory/docs/workflow.md#7-staying-current).

## Examples

```
/fc:sync-sdlc
/fc:sync-sdlc --adapters=claude
/fc:sync-sdlc --adapters=claude,codex
/fc:sync-sdlc --adapters=routing
```

## Writes

Nothing by default: drift is reported only. With `--adapters=…` it writes the selected host pointers, and only those:

- `claude`: pointers in `.claude/agents/` and `.claude/skills/` for the agents and skills this project added (the plugin's own commands and agents are native, so they get none), plus the routing agents. Generated pointers it no longer needs, in `.claude/commands/` and `.claude/agents/`, are removed.
- `codex`: `.codex/skills/fc-<name>/SKILL.md` for each task, `fc-check` for the deprecated alias of `review`, `fc-ba`, `fc-analyze` and `fc-scout` for the shortcuts of `analyse` and `explore` (no notice, and no Claude pointer since the plugin ships those commands), plus the routing agents.
- `cursor`: `.cursor/rules/ai.mdc`.
- `routing`: `.claude/agents/fc-route-*.md` and `.codex/agents/fc-route-*.toml` only.

It replaces only files it generated earlier. A hand-authored file at one of those paths stops the run before anything is written.

Only when you ask: enabling artifact contracts (`node ai-factory/make/contracts.js enable`) and, after you confirm the dry run, writing migration drafts with `contracts.js migrate --write`.

## Refuses or asks

- With no `ai-factory/` layout, reports that the command applies to scaffolded projects, and stops.
- On the pre-1.0.0 layout, reports the 1.0.0 rename and that `/fc:migrate-layout` (removed in 2.1.0) must be run from an ai-sdlc checkout at 2.0.0 or earlier, then stops without syncing.
- Never infers all hosts: adapters are generated only for hosts you name.
- Never silently copies changed templates and never hand-edits generated integration files.
